selection_rule: First lexicographic immediate-child tracked .import file in each of assets/fonts, assets/icon, assets/audio/music at I. Three bounded metadata families; no historical sample identities or count are inferred. Candidate directory entries were read before this declaration, but metadata contents have not yet been parsed or checked.
reader_closure: document, string and paths use only the two exact pinned source modules and Python standard library. No mock module, account function, subprocess/engine function, asset decoding or lazy validate_seed import is called.
planned_checks: preserve full parsed authored value strings and semantic digest
capture: One invocation. Preserve exact checker text, all three actual metadata text inputs, source hashes, full stdout/stderr, start/end/exit, wall and child CPU/rusage observations. Continue independent samples on a parse failure; no repeated-until-green check.
limits: Pure metadata reader only: no Godot Variant evaluation, generated resource, validate_seed asset-byte claim, importer execution, native writer closure or native qualification. No font, texture or audio binary is fetched or published.
